verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev's own observability product page says users can receive webhook alerts when tasks fail, which is a first-party outbound HTTP callback. The evidence covers only failure alerts, in a single marketing-level line, not a general event-subscription system. Realtime streaming is a different mechanism and is not credited. Missing for 10: a broader event catalog beyond task failures, webhook registration/configuration docs, payload schema, signing/verification and delivery-retry details, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Receive alerts via email, Slack notification and webhooks when your tasks fail.
